bootstrap_authorization: Coordinator, 2026-11-02: one reset inside unmerged #466 because postmaster accounting changed the measurement. Main had no CPU policy. This is not a precedent for growing merged CPU caps; the target-branch growth guard remains unchanged.
calibration_scope: One uncached foreground run per controller target, sequentially. GitHub has flow and notices targets. Workers exceeded the 10-minute Remote Bazel deadline with no test verdict or receipt; no retry.
coverage_note: The first publishing, simulation and prismabuild receipts used conservative binary-wide missing-PID fallbacks. The runner now detects fixture activity per scenario. Keep every recorded fallback excluded from calibration rather than reinterpret partial samples.
cpu_accounting: Test utime+stime+cutime+cstime plus owned postmaster deltas from the same counters; backends contribute when reaped. cpu_fallbacks are excluded from calibration.
method: one-time #466 full-CPU bootstrap: ceil(2 * measured max CPU), floor 1s; unmeasured caps retained
default_method: min(previous default, ceil(2 * measured p95)), floor 1s
uncalibrated_default_scenarios: All scenarios absent from max_cpu_seconds remain unmeasured. Their existing explicit caps are retained; default-budget scenarios use the default, bounded by its previous value.
follow_up: Capture a complete workers receipt and calibrate the remaining explicit caps and other targets. Collect hosted x64 and arm64 receipts before trusting these BuildBuddy-only CPU caps there. Future changes compare to the merged policy and may only shrink caps.
timeout_rationale: Largest complete target was publishing at 398.931 seconds. Workers stopped at the Remote Bazel 600-second deadline without a test verdict; this does not establish a need for a Bazel timeout above 900 seconds. Retain size=large default timeout and do not use eternal.
